items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: The name 'Heidel' is mentioned by the interviewer ('when Heidel had it') but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or confirmation of a relationship.

ctx.x: So, in other words, it was a big odd job.
Yeah, at the first, when Heidel had it, it was a big odd job.
Yeah, I see. What, you remember when you first opened up that place? You remember the first night or anything about that?
